correctness.rationale: Exact cylinder-to-tangent-ball reduction and spherical 3-point perimeter, equality classification, and standard Descartes identity establish the sharp weighted optimum. From a near-optimal radius, each of three angular slacks is bounded by the total O(epsilon) deficit. The 2x2 Gram inverse gives O(sqrt epsilon) off-great-circle contact displacement; two independent center separation vectors give O(sqrt epsilon) axis tilt via point-to-line distance inequalities. An explicit nonparallel twist has exact line distance s_ij/sqrt(1+t²H_ij²), positive linear center-distance slack, and t~sqrt epsilon, proving optimal exponent for every positive weight triple. Packaged checker passed 205 weighted cases.

Useful for studying geometry of near-critical packings and axis constraints.
